examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Web Apps band: six linked customer marks on the start edge, one of those customers speaking on the end edge. Each cell is a `card-grid` frame cell and a whole-square link to that customer’s success case — hover or `Tab` to one and a wash rises behind it, the mark lifts, and `Read story` slides in underneath. From `lg` up the band splits: the wall sits in half the width, two to a row until `xl` and three from it, and the quote is centred beside it in a panel that never sets the band’s height, so the cells stay perfect squares whatever the quotation’s length. Beside a quote the wall takes exactly six marks. iFood and Itaú carry `shape: 'compact'`, which sets a near-square mark taller so it reads at the same weight as the wordmarks. The wall assumes a surrounding `frame-box` draws its outer rules, which is why the snippet includes one.

  import herosparkLogo from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/herospark-extended-color.svg'
  import ifoodLogo from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/ifood-extended-color.svg'
  import itauLogo from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/itau-extended-color.svg'

  import nznLogo from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/nzn-extended-reversed.svg'

  import FrameBox from '@aziontech/webkit/frame-box'
  import LogoWall from '@aziontech/webkit/logo-wall'
  import Quote from '@aziontech/webkit/quote'
</script>

<template>
  <FrameBox>
    <LogoWall
      aria-label="Clients running on Azion"
      :items="[
        { src: magaluLogo, alt: 'Magalu', href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/magalu/' },
        {
          src: ifoodLogo,
          alt: 'iFood',
          href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/ifood/',
          shape: 'compact'
        },
        { src: stoneLogo, alt: 'Stone', href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/stone/' },
        {
          src: netshoesLogo,
          alt: 'Netshoes',
          href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/netshoes/'
        },
        { src: nznLogo, alt: 'NZN', href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/nzn/' },
        {
          src: itauLogo,
          alt: 'Itaú',
          href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/itau/',
          shape: 'compact'
        }
      ]"
    >
      <template #aside>
        <Quote
          kind="signed"
          :logo="herosparkLogo"
          logo-alt="HeroSpark"
          text="Azion transformed our operations, reducing costs and improving performance while freeing 200+ monthly hours for strategic development."
          name="Mateus Leonardi"
          job-title="CTO at HeroSpark"
        />
      </template>
    </LogoWall>
  </FrameBox>
</template>

examples.name: Wall
examples.summary: With nothing in `aside` the wall spans the full width, six to a row from `lg` — the same cell size as the three-column wall beside a quote, so the two layouts share one rhythm. Twelve marks fill two full rows; give the wall a multiple of six here so the last row is never ragged. Empty the `items` control and the band renders nothing rather than an empty frame.

examples.name: Rectangle
examples.summary: Nine customers beside one of them speaking. `kind: 'rectangle'` sets every cell at 3:2, and beside `aside` the wall holds three columns from `lg`, so three rows of rectangles take exactly the height two rows of squares do — the band grows by three names without growing taller. Below `sm` the wall keeps three columns, so nine marks never leave a ragged row. Every mark links to its story, so hover or `Tab` reveals `Read story` under it.
